thread:
matt.pm: Quick check from the all-hands  when you said 'flexible headcount buckets', can you explain what that means for cross-functional PM/eng pairs?

elena: Sure  not changing product ownership. Flex buckets mean hiring budget can be moved across teams within the same org ladder for the quarter to hit critical milestones.

anya.eng: Does that require sign-off from the PM org, or just Eng + People?

sophia.peopleops: It'll be a 2-step approval: manager + org lead sign-off. PMs should be looped if it affects roadmap deliverables.

matt.pm: Good  will there be a public tracker so PMs can see which positions are flexible vs reserved?

ops-bot: "Headcount tracker published: https://intra.redwood/headcount/Q2 (view-only)"

nina.recruiter: We'll tag reqs as FLEX or RESERVED in Greenhouse. Search tag = "RFLEX". If you see a FLEX you can propose reallocation via the internal form.

anya.eng: What about leveling expectations? If a role shifts teams, do we re-evaluate seniority?

sophia.peopleops: Level stays with the req. If an individual transfers, we follow the internal mobility policy review (comp manager + calibration panel). No automatic demotions.

matt.pm: Are we adjusting interview loop length for FLEX hires to speed up hiring?

devex-bot: "New loop templates posted in #devex: 2-stage loop for infra, 3-stage for senior PMs. Docs: https://intra.redwood/devex/hiring-loops"

nina.recruiter: We will fast-track high-priority FLEX reqs: aim to close in 6 weeks. Regular reqs still follow standard cadence.

anya.eng: For teams spanning timezones, can we request a hiring slot in the next wave even if the headcount is in another region?

elena: Yes, with product/ops justification. We want bandwidth in key timezones; include timezone impact in the reallocation form.

matt.pm: Is there any change to relocation or hiring stipend for these roles?

sophia.peopleops: Relocation policy unchanged. We may approve remote-first for some FLEX roles; relocation only if candidate requests and manager approves.

anya.eng: Are managers expected to carve out budget for shadowing/overlap when a role moves?

elena: Yes  plan for 2-4 weeks overlap where feasible. We'll allow temporary stretch credits to cover overlap work.

matt.pm: For cross-team hires, will onboarding include a short product sync for the new team?

sophia.peopleops: We'll create a "cross-team onboarding" checklist and 30/60/90 sync slot. Template will be in the onboarding repo.

anya.eng: Any guidance for talking to candidates if a role is labelled FLEX?

nina.recruiter: Be transparent: explain the potential for slightly different project assignments in Q1. Emphasize we prioritize stability for ICs and career growth.

ops-bot: "Hiring wave 1 prioritized: infra/runtime/observability (12 reqs). Wave 2: model-serving + platform features (8 reqs)."

elena: We'll share the wave schedule and a FAQ doc Monday. If you have specific risks, DM Sophia + your org lead.

matt.pm: Thanks  I'll synthesize into a short note for my PMs.

anya.eng: Appreciate it. I'll flag a couple teams that need earlier slots.

sophia.peopleops: Thanks all. We'll open the reallocation form today and post the updated org charts by next week.
